title: add serverless RAG quickstart (Rust + Lambda + webhook tool-calling)
author: Daniel Park
release_notes: New quickstart: Serverless RAG using Rust Lambdas with webhook-based tool-calling. Adds docs page and runnable example to redwood-examples. Non-breaking.
description: Introduce a compact serverless RAG quickstart implemented in Rust and deployable to AWS Lambda (via provided SAM template). Motivation: several customers asked for a minimal, low-cost RAG pattern that can run on short-lived serverless workers and demonstrates Redwood tool-calling via webhooks. This PR adds a beginner-friendly tutorial, a small Rust agent binary that performs incremental retrieval + model calls, and a documented webhook shim that demonstrates tool-calling and structured outputs. The guide emphasizes production considerations: cold-start mitigation, KV-cache compatibility, batching recommendations, and security boundary guidance for webhooks. Checklist: - [x] Add rust example code and build script - [x] Add SAM template and deployment instructions - [x] Add docs page in quickstarts/serverless-rag-rust - [x] Add tests for local run and endpoint smoke test - [x] CI: ensure cargo fmt/clippy and integration test run - [x] Add README with cost/latency expectations Notable user-facing changes: - docs/quickstarts/serverless-rag-rust/README.md: step-by-step with deploy commands and sample prompts - examples/serverless-rag-rust/src/main.rs: minimal agent loop + simple VectorDB client adapter (file-backed for example) - examples/serverless-rag-rust/webhook/tool_adapter.py: small Python webhook that receives Redwood tool-calling payloads and returns structured JSON (shows function call handling) - examples/serverless-rag-rust/template.yaml: AWS SAM template for a single Lambda + API Gateway route Testing notes: ran integration smoke tests against dedicated dev Redwood instance (localstack for AWS resources). Initial CI flake: first run failed clippy due to an unused_result in the example; fixed in commit c3f9d6a. Security: webhook shim is explicitly marked as example-only; README warns about auth, TLS, and secrets in production. Docs updated on docs-site navigation tree under Quickstarts > Serverless RAG (Rust + Lambda). Related: ENG-3120 for customer ask; PM-678 for product coverage.

merge_commit_message:
Add serverless RAG quickstart (Rust + Lambda + webhook tool-calling)

Adds example Rust agent, webhook tool shim, SAM template, docs quickstart, and CI tests. Addresses ENG-3120.
notes_for_qa: Smoke test steps included in README: 1) setup localstack and REDWOOD_URL env var 2) cargo build --release 3) sam local start-api --env-vars env.json 4) run tests/integration/test_serverless_rag.py. QA should validate: webhook call returns structured JSON for tool calls, agent persists embeddings in the InMemoryAdapter for session, and Redwood requests include appropriate model selection headers.
security_considerations: Example webhook is example-only: no authentication, disabled by default in SAM template. README contains warnings: use API Gateway auth, enable TLS, don't store API keys in code, and rotate keys. Recommend customers use Redwood Private or Dedicated for regulated workloads.
estimated_runtime_notes: On minimal Lambda (512MB) cold-starts ~300-500ms for the small Rust binary, typical end-to-end RAG request (single doc retrieval + 128-token generation on a small open model) ~600-900ms. Batching and KV cache can reduce p99 significantly; see Optimize recommendations in README.
